x: Len Fletcher returned fastest time and Jack Rathbone second fastest—a good performance, for only three weeks before he was competing in the London—Brighton Race. H. C Larman proved to be the best of the newcomers, and he should lose his "novice" rank very soon.
Redgrave has walked splendidly in his last three races and Harley finds a little extra speed each week. H.

In the 7 miles event promoted by the Cambridge Harriers, our "A" team easily won the scratch team event, while the "B" team annexed the handicap team first prizes. In addition, Harry Larman, a persevering and improving walker, was placed second in the individual handicap.
